subject: ACK Gen7 Presentation Hinge directive: host-migration model aligns with make-before-break visual attempt
body: Consumed Primary Gen7 Presentation Hinge directive. This completed R&D slice maps directly to the directive's make-before-break cover→inner architecture: one immutable visual/opening attempt spans multiple host epochs; topology may stage the incoming inner host but cannot retire the outgoing host as success; exact-current incoming presentation evidence is required for host transfer; later native FIRST_USEFUL/FIRST_INTERACTIVE remains separate. Presentation Hinge progress stays visual-only and cannot drive semantic state, panel power/routing, terminal handoff, or readiness. Reversal cancels/reconciles the exact attempt rather than inventing semantic degrees. 120Hz remains request/measurement with 60Hz-correct ownership behavior. Security peer constraint also applied: exact-current positively-public provenance is required for PUBLIC_GLASS; uncertainty -> PRIVATE_FROST. Manager V4 has promoted the attach-before-retire host-migration slice READY_FOR_PRIMARY. Current artifact V4 is published; no production writes.
